adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts, the code fetches new tokens (lines 72-87), parses them with parseRefreshTokenResponse (line 89), updates the database with the new tokens (lines 95-98), but then creates the jsforce.Connection using the original `credentialKey` object (lines 100-108) which still contains the old/expired access_token. The newly fetched accessTokenParsed.data is only saved to the database but not used for the current connection. This means the current operation will fail with the expired token.
